description_full:
Info magang dari Merauke Sugar Group

Are you a final-year student or recent graduate who enjoys creating visual content, exploring fresh creative ideas, and bringing concepts to life through multimedia? Here's your chance to turn your creative skills into meaningful professional experience!

Join our Paid Internship Program as a Creative Multimedia Intern and be part of the Corporate Communication Team at Merauke Sugar Group in Jakarta.

📲 Scan the QR code on the poster to submit your application!

[poster text]
INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY
MERAUKE SUGAR GROUP
Creative Multimedia Intern
Full WFO - Jakarta
Things to Check Before You Apply
● Preferably a fresh graduate or final-year student majoring in
Visual Communication Design, Multimedia, Creative Media, or a
related field.
• Proficient in design and video editing tools, such as Adobe
SCAN TO APPLY
Creative Suite, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, CapCut,
or equivalent applications.
• Have a good understanding of multimedia content formats, visual
communication, and current digital trends.
Creative, proactive, and initiative-driven, with a willingness to
learn, openness to feedback, and the ability to collaborate
effectively within a team.
Key Responsibilities
• Create visual content to support internal and external corporate
communications.
• Produce and edit photos, videos, graphic designs, and other visual
materials.
• Develop visual assets for multimedia content and various
corporate communication needs.
www.meraukesugargroup.com
